text:
Diego M: Heads-up — we need a hotpatch for 2.4.3. Small-batch path regression causing ~0.7% 5xxs on high-concurrency. Cutting window in 2h. Keep diffs minimal; no model/retrain work.

Ashok: ack. thanks for the ping. what's the proposed branch strategy?

Diego M: branch from release/2.4 -> hotfix/2.4.3-patch. We'll cherry-pick only the fix and the unit test. No config or infra changes unless critical.

Priya: I have a tiny PR ready with the fix + test, pushing now. pinging reviewers @Jen L and @Sam. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4821

Jen L: on it. quick question — does the patch change any API surface or require client bumps?

Diego M: no API changes. Only internal request batching logic. clients unaffected.

Sam: I'll review right after lunch. can we also add one-line changelog under "patches"? keeps release notes consistent.

Diego M: yes, please. keep it terse: "fix: small-batch 5xx regression under high concurrency". No long writeup.

Priya: CI is running. if tests pass I'll request a reviewer and mark for expedited merge.

deploy-bot: CI: build #4821 passed (unit + lint) — all green.

Priya: tests passed, requested @Jen L and @Sam for review, adding label hotfix/urgent.

Jen L: reviewed, left one tiny nit in test naming. approving once that's addressed.

Priya: fixed the name, amended commit, force-pushed.

release-captain: tagging for cut: cutoff in 90 minutes. plan: merge hotfix/2.4.3-patch -> release/2.4, run quick smoke in staging, then canary deploy to 5% traffic. If no regressions in 30 mins, promote to 50% then 100%.

Ashok: can we skip the canary for 5% and go straight to 20%? we need faster mitigation for customer-facing errors.

Diego M: prefer to keep 5% initial to catch surprising telemetry. but ok bump to 15% if metrics look good at 10m.

Sam: rolling plan sounds good. I'll monitor error rates and rollback trigger is >0.5% increase in 5xxs for 5 consecutive minutes.

Priya: merging PR now with squash.

deploy-bot: deploy started: hotfix/2.4.3-patch -> staging (build 4823).

Diego M: monitoring dashboards (link) — watching prefix KV hits and small-batch latency. will post updates here.

Jen L: if anything blocks promotion, shout here. otherwise I'll sign off on changelog release note. :thumbsup:

release-captain: noted. final reminder: do not introduce any new feature flags or config gating in this cut. Keep rollback path clean.

Diego M: thanks everyone. I'll post status updates in this thread.

(10:45) Diego M: staging smoke looks clean at +12m. 5xx rate back to baseline. promoting to canary 5%.

(10:58) Sam: canary stable at 5% for 10m, promoting to 50%.

(11:20) release-captain: 50% stable, scheduling full rollout in 10m.

(11:33) deploy-bot: hotfix 2.4.3 deployed to 100% — all stages green.

(11:35) Diego M: closing the thread — postmortem will be a one-pager if any follow-ups needed. thanks for the quick turn. :rocket:
